Rigger – Full-Time
Location: Welshpool, Western Australia 6106
Employment Type: Full-Time
Salary: $80,000 – $110,000 per annum (depending on skills and experience)

MINPROVISE INTERNATIONAL PTY LTD is a leading total solutions provider delivering specialist maintenance and shutdown services, engineering, fabrication, project services, and sustaining capital works. We also provide a comprehensive range of equipment and products, supporting the mining, oil & gas, and construction industries across Australia and internationally.

We are currently seeking experienced and motivated Riggers to join our growing team on a full-time basis.

About the Role
As a Rigger, you will be responsible for planning, preparing, and performing rigging operations to safely lift, move, position, and secure heavy machinery, structural steel, equipment, and materials across mining, oil & gas, construction, and industrial projects. You will work closely with crane operators, engineers, supervisors, and other trades to ensure lifting activities are carried out safely and efficiently in accordance with Australian Standards and site requirements.

Key Responsibilities
•	Read and interpret lifting plans, engineering drawings, and work instructions.
•	Plan and perform rigging operations for lifting, positioning, and installation of heavy equipment and structural components.
•	Select, inspect, and safely use lifting gear, including slings, chains, wire ropes, shackles, spreader bars, lifting beams, and hoists.
•	Direct crane operators using standard hand signals and radio communications during lifting operations.
•	Assemble, dismantle, align, and secure heavy machinery, plant, structural steel, and industrial equipment.
•	Conduct pre-start inspections of rigging equipment and ensure all lifting gear is certified and fit for use.
•	Identify hazards, assess lifting risks, and implement appropriate control measures.
•	Assist with shutdowns, maintenance projects, equipment installations, and major construction activities.
•	Maintain accurate records of lifting equipment inspections and completed work where required.
•	Work collaboratively with supervisors, engineers, crane operators, and other trades to ensure projects are completed safely and on schedule.
•	Follow all workplace health and safety policies, procedures, and environmental requirements.

Skills and Experience
•	Minimum 1–2 years of full-time experience as a Rigger in mining, construction, or heavy industrial environments.
•	Current High Risk Work Licence – Rigging (Basic, Intermediate, or Advanced).
•	Strong knowledge of lifting techniques, rigging equipment, and safe lifting practices.
•	Ability to read and interpret lifting plans, engineering drawings, and technical specifications.
•	Experience working with cranes, heavy equipment, structural steel, and mechanical installations.
•	Strong commitment to workplace safety and compliance with Australian Standards.
•	Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
•	Excellent communication, problem-solving, and organisational skills.

What We Offer
•	Full-time, permanent employment.
•	Competitive salary of $80,000 – $110,000 per annum.
•	Opportunities to work on major mining, shutdown, and industrial projects.
•	Ongoing training and career development.
•	Supportive team environment with long-term career opportunities.

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Your role at St John of God Health Care 

As a Senior Cyber and Operational Technology Security Engineer you will be at the heart of our security operations helping to safeguard the organisation from cyber threats. You will be responsible for the design, implementation and maintenance of the digital security systems and processes that protect our caregivers, patients, and information.

Additionally, you will be responsible for overseeing cyber security engineering of St John of God Health Care's Operational Technology (OT) - including facilities, clinical - medical operational technologies, and associated Internet of Things (IoT) devices - to protect, detect and respond to cyber threats across the organisation.

The Position

Building, operating, and continuously improving cybersecurity tools and processes

Act as the senior SME for integrated OT, cloud, and data security, providing authoritative technical guidance on secure architecture, design patterns, and control implementation.

Support the design and maintenance of OT security reference architectures aligned to Australian regulatory requirements and industry standards (including AS-IEC 62443 and Purdue principles), incorporating segmentation, DMZs, and least-privilege remote access.

Establish and maintain OT asset discovery and inventory using passive, protocol-aware techniques, and configure and tune monitoring and anomaly-detection capabilities in safety-critical environments.

Provide senior technical input to IT-OT network segmentation initiatives in collaboration with network, facilities, and engineering teams.

Provide technical oversight and integration guidance for enterprise security platforms (including SIEM, XDR-EDR, CASB, vulnerability management, and firewalls), including OT telemetry integration, in collaboration with SOC-MSSP providers.

Establish and maintain visibility, security baselines, and monitoring for IoT and connected devices supporting facilities and clinical operations, ensuring OT-safe methods that protect service continuity and safety.

Define and maintain OT-appropriate vulnerability, patching, cyber risk controls, and change management approaches that balance cyber risk reduction with clinical safety and service availability.

Define, implement and assure OT vendor and supply-chain security controls, including secure remote access patterns (jump hosts, MFA, time-bound access, monitoring), contractual security requirements, and validation of third-party controls for clinical and facilities technologies.

Lead OT cyber risk assessments and security uplift planning aligned to AS-IEC 62443 concepts (e.g., zone-conduit design and target security levels), ensuring risk treatments are practical for safety-critical operations and clinical environments.

Provide senior technical input into cyber incident preparedness and response across IT and OT environments, including developing OT-safe runbooks, supporting incident detection and remediation, and contributing to exercises and readiness assessments..

Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external vendors to investigate, resolve, and document incidents, ensuring root-cause analysis and lessons learned inform future improvements.

You will have demonstrated technical understanding and expertise in OT security and architecture, with demonstrated experience integrating OT controls with enterprise cyber security capabilities (e.g., SIEM-XDR, identity controls, and data protection-DLP) where OT systems interface with IT or cloud platforms. Additionally you will have strong demonstrable experience supporting cyber incident response and management activities across IT and OT environments.

To succeed you will have:

At least three years' experience in equivalent roles

Tertiary qualified in Information Systems, Cyber Security or a related discipline, and - or hold relevant industry Security Certifications (CSEC ,CEH, OSCP, vendor certifications, etc.)

Experience in health care, or a critical infrastructure industry will be looked upon favourably.

Above all, people will be at the core of everything you do committing to and supporting our Mission and Values.

We can offer you

Salary: $160,267 to $173,035 base per annum, plus 12% superannuation

Permanent full-time position working 76 hours per fortnight

Located at Perth CBD (Kings Square) or Melbourne CBD (Collins St) offices

Hybrid working arrangements

Salary packaging up to $18,550 on a range of benefits such as mortgage, rent, meal entertainment, holiday accommodation or other everyday living expenses as well as options to salary package benefits above the FBT cap on items such as:

Novated leasing 

work related expenses

self-education and

additional superannuation

Employee discount on St John of God Hospital & Medical Services and Private Health Insurance

Employee support through our dedicated free Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

A healthy work-life balance through flexible work options, additional purchased leave and well-being programs

Access to a range of Lifestyle, Health & Wellbeing rewards and discounts

End of trip bike and shower facilities (Perth only)

Close to Public Transport

If suitable applicants are identified advertisement may close prior to listed date and screening-interviews may commence throughout the advertising process.

Please note unsolicited applications from recruitment agencies will not be accepted. 

St John of God Health Care embraces diversity and strongly encourages applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples and people with disabilities. We are committed to providing a safe environment for all children and vulnerable people in our care and proactively take measures to protect children-vulnerable people from abuse. result.description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Toolmaker – Moulding to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the maintenance, repair, refurbishment, modification, and manufacture of moulding tools and equipment used in production. This role requires strong technical expertise, problem-solving ability, and a commitment to quality and safety.

Monday - Friday, 6:00am - 2:30pm
$40 - $45 per hour

Key Responsibilities
Manufacture, assemble, and fit precision mould tools, components, and fixtures.
Perform maintenance, repair, and modification of existing moulds to ensure optimal performance.
Read and interpret technical drawings, CAD files, and engineering specifications.
Collaborate with engineering, production and maintenance teams to troubleshoot tooling and moulding issues.
Conduct testing and commissioning of new mould tools.
Ensure moulds meet required tolerances and quality standards.
Operate toolroom machinery such as manual and CNC machines including lathes, milling machines, grinders, EDM and drilling equipment.
Perform preventative maintenance and ensure tooling is production ready.
Identify process improvements to increase efficiency and reduce downtime.
Maintain accurate records of tool modifications, repairs, and maintenance schedules.
Follow workplace health and safety regulations at all times.

Qualifications, Experience and Skills
Trade qualification in Toolmaking, Fitter & Turner, or equivalent.
Proven experience in mould manufacture, maintenance, refurbishment, and repair making, preferably
           in injection moulding, blow moulding, die-casting, or similar manufacturing processes.
Strong knowledge of machining processes (CNC, milling, turning, grinding, EDM).
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and specifications.
High attention to detail and precision.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Experience with CAD/CAM software (desirable).
Good communication and teamwork skills.
Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
General Construction Induction Certificate (Blue/White Card)
Current Working at Heights and Confined Space tickets
Current valid Driver’s license

Articulated Moxy Operator (FIFO Darwin)  
   
 Are you ready to take the next step in your career and join a high-performing team in the Northern Territory? We are currently seeking an experienced Articulated Moxy Operators for a project that values precision, safety, and operational excellence. If you hold tickets for other mobile plant equipment, we strongly encourage you to apply as well. 
   
  About your new role  
   
 You will be an integral part of the civil crew, responsible for the safe and efficient transport of bulk earthworks across the project site. Your daily contributions will be vital to keeping operations moving and hitting production targets. 
 
  Operate Articulated Moxy safely daily  
  Load and unload bulk materials  
  Maintain accurate machine pre-starts  
  Collaborate with the civil team  
  Adhere to strict safety guidelines  
 
  What you will need to exceed  
   
 To be successful in this position, you must bring a strong commitment to safety and operational efficiency. We are looking for operators who take initiative and work well within a dynamic team environment. 
 
  Minimum 2 years operational experience  
  Current Articulated Moxy ticket required  
  Ability to pass pre-employment medical  
  Valid Australian driver's licence  
  Strong safety and reliability focus  
  Experience in other mobile plant advantageous  
 
  What you will get in return  
   
 You will be working on a premium site that values your rest and wellbeing. 
 
  FIFO roster: 21 days on, 8 days rest - roster changes towards end of 2026  
  Flights from Darwin to site provided  
  Access to gym and pool facilities  
  Competitive hourly rates  
  Supportive and professional team environment  
 
  Note: Interstate applicants are welcome to apply; however, you will be required to cover your own travel expenses to Darwin for FIFO departure.  
   
  Your new company  
   
 You will be joining a well-established project environment known for its high standards and commitment to excellence. The site provides a comfortable lifestyle with excellent accommodation and recreational facilities to help you recharge between shifts. 
   
  Next steps  
   
 If you are ready to hit the ground running, click the 'Apply' button to submit your resume. 
   
 If you have any questions, please contact Vanessa Sands at vanessa.sands@randstad.com.au. 

 At Randstad, we are passionate about providing equal employment opportunities and embracing diversity to the benefit of all. We actively encourage applications from any background. 
   
    Please  click here  to apply.

result.description:
Nu-Tank is a family-owned business that started in 2008, we supply superior products, deliver top tier customer service and most importantly give back to our community.

Nu-Tank manufactures polyethylene tanks, feeders and troughs. Retailing water tanks, molasses and dunder tanks, diesel storage tanks, transport, industrial tanks, firefighter units, wet and dry lick feeders, water and molasses troughs, pumps and accessories, round steel tanks and self-bunded tanks.

They are seeking highly skilled WELDERS to join their team of professionals in a full-time and permanent basis.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Read and interpret project plans, engineering drawings, blueprints and other written instructions and diagrams to perform task at hand
Perform fabrication and repair works on various metal structures and components according to engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Work with variety of materials, including steel, aluminium, and other alloys
Weld small and large components such as copper plumbing, beams, and pipelines.
Perform appropriate type of weld - base on project needs and specifications
Weld components in flat, vertical, and overhead positions.
Ensure fabrication and repairs are carried out using the proper safety guidelines to ensure rework jobs do not occur.
Use a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Conduct quality checks on completed work to ensure it meets standard specifications
Monitor machinery for appropriate usage and temperature
Follow and enforce strict safety regulations such as wearing heat-resistant gloves, protective masks, and safety shoes to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace.

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Trade certificate in Engineering Fabrication or Equivalent
Proficient in performing all welding, gouging, cutting or other duties
Post trade experience in the same field
Proactive attitude with the desire to work reliably as part of an outstanding team to deliver excellence for our clients
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Experience working with a variety of materials, including steel, aluminum, and other alloys
Familiarity with a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Strong attention to detail and the ability to conduct quality checks on completed work
Ability to work independently or as part of a team to complete assigned tasks
Knowledge of safety procedures and regulations to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace
Strong communication and reporting skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $75,000 and $80,000 per annum + Super

result.description:
Over the last 20 years, ABC Heavy Engineering has grown as a locally owned and operated company. Becoming an industry leader isn’t an easy feat, but through our ongoing ingenuity and commitment to research and development, we are a leading multi-disciplinary engineering company. We have a vast range of experience in all aspects of heavy engineering meaning that we can manage, monitor, repair, revive and restore heavy machinery across many industries.

ABC Heavy Engineering are seeking to employ suitably qualified PAINTERS to join our busy team of professionals working out of our Paget depot and various field sites in Queensland.
We are looking for trustworthy individuals with integrity who will bring a positive can-do attitude to the position and to the team.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Read blueprints/instructions, examine, and understand surfaces to determine the kind and amount of work necessary
Make work preparation such as scaffolding, covering fixtures
Responsible for mixing, matching, applying paint to various surfaces, and completing touch-ups
Be able to understand and complete works to specifications
Be able to mix correct ratio two-part paint coatings etc
Proper appropriation of consumables and materials to avoid wastage
Select paints, varnishes and stains to various surfaces using brushes, sprays, and rollers
Understand the use of Wet Film Thickness Gauges and be able to achieve specified dry film thickness
Able to carry out minor repairs as and when deemed necessary
Use different tools and brushes to apply paints with attention to details
Be able to work at heights and in confined spaces
Erecting scaffolding and ladders
Cleaning equipment and work areas
Support other team members to ensure completion of projects are on-time and in accordance to specification

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Trade Certificate –Certificate III in Surface Preparation or equivalent (for Blaster/Painters)
High Risk Licence for EWP and/or Forklift
Trade Qualifications in Protective Coatings (ACA, NACE, ICorr, or other trade certs)
HR licence, high risk licence with EWP and Forklift
Drivers Licence (MR or HR class)
Ability to work well both independently and in a team environment
Ability to meet strict deadlines
Strong communication skills
Keen attention to detail
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super
